meta.title: Approval notifications
meta.description: Raises a macOS Notification Center banner at the four moments an agent waits for you: a tool approval, an ask_user_question prompt, a finished turn, and a session error, each with its own switch. The alert tone rides along with the banner and is played by the system (approval Glass, question Ping, finish Tink, error Basso); finish reminders are skipped while DSH is frontmost, and error reminders are limited to one per five minutes so a failing automation cannot fill the notification center. Switches, a test notice, a self-check and the four counters live in Settings → Plugins → Approval notifications. Banners are posted through osascript, so macOS attributes them to Script Editor and they do not open the session. Approval reminders only appear while the permission preset asks for approval (read-only or workspace-write); the full-access preset rejects those calls outright, so nothing is announced. The plugin never answers an approval or a question.
